# Configuration reference

Everything is environment-driven, prefixed `SEOOS_`, so the same image
runs locally, in CI and in production.

**Nothing below is required to start.** With an empty environment the
platform runs on SQLite, crawls and audits any public site, and marks
generative steps as degraded rather than failing.

| Variable | Type | Default | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| `SEOOS_APP_NAME` | str | `SEO OS` |  |
| `SEOOS_ENVIRONMENT` | Literal | `dev` |  |
| `SEOOS_PUBLIC_URL` | str | `http://localhost:8000` |  |
| `SEOOS_WEB_URL` | str | `http://localhost:3000` |  |
| `SEOOS_DATABASE_URL` | str | `sqlite+aiosqlite:///./seoos.db` | SQLite for development, Postgres for anything concurrent |
| `SEOOS_DATABASE_ECHO` | bool | `false` |  |
| `SEOOS_REDIS_URL` | str \| None | - |  |
| `SEOOS_MASTER_KEY` | str | - | Encrypts every tenant credential. Losing it makes them unrecoverable |
| `SEOOS_JWT_SECRET` | str | - | Signs session tokens |
| `SEOOS_JWT_TTL_MINUTES` | int | `720` |  |
| `SEOOS_ALLOW_INSECURE_DEV_KEYS` | bool | `true` | Set false in production so a missing key is a hard failure |
| `SEOOS_DEFAULT_LLM_PROVIDER` | str | `anthropic` | Which provider to try first; a tenant's own key still wins |
| `SEOOS_DEFAULT_LLM_MODEL` | str | `claude-sonnet-5` |  |
| `SEOOS_DEFAULT_FAST_MODEL` | str | `claude-haiku-4-5-20251001` |  |
| `SEOOS_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` | str \| None | - |  |
| `SEOOS_OPENAI_API_KEY` | str \| None | - |  |
| `SEOOS_GOOGLE_API_KEY` | str \| None | - |  |
| `SEOOS_OPENROUTER_API_KEY` | str \| None | - |  |
| `SEOOS_AZURE_OPENAI_ENDPOINT` | str \| None | - |  |
| `SEOOS_AZURE_OPENAI_API_KEY` | str \| None | - |  |
| `SEOOS_OLLAMA_BASE_URL` | str \| None | - |  |
| `SEOOS_LLM_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` | int | `300` |  |
| `SEOOS_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID` | str \| None | - |  |

## Generating the keys

```bash
seoos keygen
```

Outside development the platform refuses to start without both
`SEOOS_MASTER_KEY` and `SEOOS_JWT_SECRET`.

## Model providers

Setting any one of these enables the generative agents. Setting none is
supported: deterministic analysis still runs.

| Variable | Provider |
|---|---|
| `SEOOS_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` | Anthropic |
| `SEOOS_OPENAI_API_KEY` | OpenAI |
| `SEOOS_GOOGLE_API_KEY` | Google |
| `SEOOS_OPENROUTER_API_KEY` | OpenRouter |
| `SEOOS_AZURE_OPENAI_API_KEY` + `SEOOS_AZURE_OPENAI_ENDPOINT` | Azure |
| `SEOOS_OLLAMA_BASE_URL` | A local Ollama endpoint |
